hero.title: Multi-CLI Environment Switcher
hero.tagline-1: enter a zen-like flow state for programming.
hero.subtitle: Unified management for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode configurations with API proxy auto-failover
features.title: Features
features.multiCli.title: Multi-CLI Support
features.multiCli.desc: Support for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode with per-project configuration
features.multiConfig.title: Config Management
features.multiConfig.desc: Manage all API provider configs in a unified JSON file
features.daemon.title: Unified Daemon
features.daemon.desc: Single zend process hosts both the proxy server and the Web UI
features.failover.title: Proxy Failover
features.failover.desc: Built-in HTTP proxy with automatic failover when primary provider is unavailable
features.routing.title: Scenario Routing
features.routing.desc: Intelligent routing based on request characteristics (thinking, image, etc.)
features.binding.title: Project Bindings
features.binding.desc: Bind directories to specific profiles and CLIs for automatic project-level configuration
features.envVars.title: Environment Variables
features.envVars.desc: Configure per-CLI environment variables at the provider level
features.webUi.title: Web Interface
features.webUi.desc: Browser-based visual management with password-protected access
features.webSecurity.title: Web Security
features.webSecurity.desc: Auto-generated password, session-based auth, RSA encryption for token transport
features.configSync.title: Config Sync
features.configSync.desc: Sync providers, profiles, and settings across devices with AES-256-GCM encryption
features.comingSoon: More features coming soon, stay tuned!

commands.items.start: Start CLI (uses project binding or default config)

commands.items.configSync: Pull config from remote sync backend
